Wu shares how Cresta, the AI operating system for customer experience behind brands like United Airlines, Comcast and Marriott, built Sentry to detect whether a caller is a person or an AI agent, which agent it is and whether it has disclosed itself, so businesses can set clear rules for each. He also explains Cresta’s new Deputy Agent, which keeps working after you hang up by taking on the manual back office tasks that follow a call.
